sources.title: How to map invoice rows in HTTP POST module so that multiple rows would be created?
sources.text: I cannot map array data for dynamic amount of invoice rows to the HTTP POST module’s “invoice rows” section.
taskExcerpts: I cannot map array data for dynamic amount of invoice rows to the HTTP POST module’s “invoice rows” section.

spans.text: What is your goal? Creating invoices in an external system with REST API based on CRM data from Airtable. What is the problem & what have you tried? I cannot map array data for dynamic amount of invoice rows to the HTTP POST module’s “invoice rows” section. I have tried without “Map” on, but then I can only see one of the values, and I cannot figure out how to do with “Map” on. I guess a basic question is if I even should be able to map the values directly to the HTTP POST module, or if I would need to some other “re-packaging” module before that? For some reason I cannot upload more than one screenshot, so I chose the mapping view with “Map” enabled.

Error messages or input/output bundles Example of Airtable’s “Get Record” output data, where two values exist: { “Bundle 1”: { “Hinta 0% (from Ostettu tuote)”: [ 390.4382470119522, 79.6812749003984 ], “VAT rate (from Ostettu tuote)”: [ 0.255, 0.255 ], “Hinta 25.5% (from Ostettu tuote)”: [ 490, 100 ] } Screenshots (scenario flow, module settings, errors)

taskExcerpts: To save email resume properly, i need immutable id to reference original email of the resume.

spans.text: My use case: To save email resume properly, i need immutable id to reference original email of the resume. This allow me to build a system where every single new email is resume like : “X person ask X person if there is a possibility to do X in comparaison of original X” This remove more than 80% of useless token and simplify the context for smaller llm to understand a long email conversation with many ping pong and person inside. I use it to create draft prefill with the good knowledge + compact history of the conversation with each mail resume Any resources to support this? Are you willing to work on this? It’s already done, check out here and feel free to ask me ANYTHING that could increase the speed for a merge, i think this feature is very light but very important when you realise how microsoft manage by default id that can change for no technical reason…
